input.quote: ARTICLE XXI EFFECT OF TERMINATION Upon termination of this Agreement: for any reason (a) the rights and licenses granted to Licensee pursuant to this Agreement will automatically terminate, and (b) Licensee shall, within five (5) days, ship to Licensor all Licensed Technology, API's Documentation with respect to the Licensed Technology and other Confidential Information in Licensee's possession or control
input.rationale: The agreement contains no post-termination transition assistance or return of our data. Article XXI (p0138) is one-directional: it terminates our licence and requires us to ship all Licensed Technology, documentation and Confidential Information back to Licensor within five days with officer certification, but imposes no reciprocal obligation on Licensor to assist with migration or to return our trading data. Searches for transition/migration/export/data return found nothing (only export-control and liability references), and the General Provisions (sec-p0144) and confidentiality article (p0123-p0125) contain no exit or data-return mechanics; the confidentiality obligation runs only against us. Because this is a hosted FX trading platform through which our market data and trade tickets flow, the absence of any data-return or assistance right falls short of even the fallback (90 days' assistance, export within 30 days) and approaches walk-away territory (no data return at all). The redline inserts the preferred position as a new Article XXI(c): up to six months' transition assistance at then-current rates, return of Licensee Data in a machine-readable format within 30 days, and certified deletion thereafter, with the 90-day fallback offered in the comment.

proposal.summary: Insert post-termination transition assistance and Licensee data return/deletion obligations in Article XXI
proposal.comment: [Playbook] Article XXI only covers our return of Licensor property, so we have added the reciprocal exit obligations: up to six months of transition assistance at Licensor's then-current rates, return of our data in a machine-readable format within 30 days, and certified deletion thereafter. This is our standard exit position; we can work with 90 days of assistance if six months is difficult.

ops.text: (c) Upon expiry or termination of this Agreement for any reason, Licensor shall (i) at Licensee's request, provide reasonable transition assistance for up to six (6) months at Licensor's then-current rates; (ii) within thirty (30) days of such expiry or termination, return to Licensee all Licensee Data (meaning all data, records, trade information and other content provided by or on behalf of Licensee, or generated for Licensee through use of the Licensed Technology) in a commonly used, machine-readable format; and (iii) thereafter delete all Licensee Data from its systems and certify such deletion in writing to Licensee.
